name: Collection header
description: Opens a collection page with a breadcrumb, the collection title, an optional clamped description with Read more, the live product count, and an optional image or sub-collection links.

fields.name: Collection
fields.helpText: Leave empty on a collection page to use that collection.

fields.name: Title
fields.helpText: Overrides the collection title. Falls back to the collection title from the store when left empty.

fields.name: Description
fields.helpText: The first sentence or two show; the rest sits behind Read more. Falls back to the collection description from the store when left empty.

fields.name: Image
fields.helpText: image variant only. Falls back to the collection image, then to the text-only layout. Needs alt text, or is marked decorative.

fields.name: Show breadcrumb
fields.helpText: Turn off when the page has a Breadcrumbs block.

fields.name: Trail
fields.description: The levels between the top of the site and this collection, root first — this theme's stand-in for the page tree, the same convention the Breadcrumbs block uses. The collection title is always the last, current level.

fields.name: Sub-collections
fields.description: Pill links under the text, e.g. Sweaters, Cardigans.

fields.name: Current page
fields.helpText: Marks this pill as the collection page currently open.
